summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun binary from oven-sh's GitHub release archive into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727 KB Bun-compiled script beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and consisting of a large scrambled string/opcode array plus a rotator function (`WV8StW` pushing/shifting an array of ~2000 mixed number/string entries) — a string-array + rotator obfuscator shape. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library for marketing direct-mail postcards; nothing in that purpose requires a second language runtime to be fetched and used to execute an opaque bundled script during `npm install`. The Bun runtime here is being used as an execution vehicle for obfuscated code that Node-based tooling is not expected to inspect. The dropper fires automatically on default install via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
